gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water and Sewer enterprise columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = operating revenues + interest income. Water: Charges for services 346,039 + Connect/disconnect fees 2,739 + Other revenue 1,333 + Interest income 3,470 = 353,581; Sewer: Charges for services 235,619. 353,581 + 235,619 = 589,200 = statement total.
